title: Brand configuration
description: Product name, identifiers and hosts of Scribe (copied from chat-next/brand.config.schema.json @a5be0b4, trimmed to what Scribe ships; keep in sync until a shared package exists). Renaming the product means editing this file, running pnpm brand:gen and rebuilding; no product name is hard-coded in web code.

colors.description: Manifest colours; each must equal its token in src/styles/tokens.css (primary = --c-primary-solid, background = light --c-bg, backgroundDark = dark --c-bg), which a brand test checks.

icon.description: Master icon (SVG), relative to web/: favicon and the rounded PNG icons.

iconMaskable.description: Full-bleed icon (SVG) whose artwork stays inside the central 80% circle: manifest maskable icons and the Apple touch icon.

appIds.description: Store identifiers. Changing one makes the store treat it as a different app.

urlScheme.description: Private-use URI scheme (RFC 8252) of the native OIDC redirect; must match OIDC_MOBILE_REDIRECT_URI of the server and the redirect the IdP registers for scribe-mobile.

hostTemplates.description: Hosts of one tenant; {domain} is the tenant's domain.
